name: obsidian-organize
description: Topic-organizer for Obsidian vaults. Five skills — bootstrap (vault layout), process_clippings (turn raw Clippings/ files into wiki/<topic>/ entries), research (gather source material), add_wiki (promote to topic note), remove_wiki (retire topic + archive). Layout mirrors hermes-wiki-super's Clippings-processed / wiki / wiki-map structure.
